Save at least 10% when buying a pack vs buying singles on downlights – 6 pack code 695RE.

The Saxby CosmosEco V3 is a dimmable, fire-rated LED recessed downlight, offering safe and efficient illumination for indoor spaces. This 6W chrome downlight, emitting 500 lumens of warm white 3000K light, is ideal for bathrooms, kitchens, and commercial applications. Installation is swift due to its 4-way, screwless push-fit terminal block and a simple 57mm holesaw requirement. The robust steel body and IP65 rating ensure durability and protection from water, providing 50,000 hours of consistent light with a 65° beam angle.
